newsitem.title: INDIA: India castor up on speculative buying.
newsitem.headline: India castor up on speculative buying.

text.p: Castorseed September delivery moved up to 1,175/1,176 rupees per quintal from 1,167/1,168 rupees on the back of fresh speculative buying, floor sources said.
Limited supplies and continued buying by shippers aided buoyancy.
"Shippers are short and covering by them lifted prices in the spot and forward markets," one operator said.
The Bombay Oil Exchange has formally opened castorseed December delivery and the new contract was thinly traded at 1,181/1,182 rupees per quintal.
"Tehnically September delivery is now overbought and a downward correction is due," a operator added.
Groundnut oil climbed up by two rupees at 375/376 rupees per 10 kg on the back of seasonal buying for the approaching festival season while inflow was at low ebb.
In Rajkot spot groundnut oil was steady at 595 rupees per 15 kg.
In Bombay imported palm-oil was steady at 256/257 rupees per 10 kg but sentiment was subdued on reports of arrivals of 4,000/5,000 tonnes of imported palm-oil at Mumbai port.
"We are expecting more arrivals in the coming days," dealer said.
